items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each guard is a short, clearly named `is_cached` check. A comment explains why: "Don't override a value already cached by a nested prefetch." Formatting matches the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing field cache API (`is_cached`) and adds no new bookkeeping. The same small guard appears in three parallel spots, each following that spot's existing pattern. No debug leftovers; the temporary test file was deleted.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The guard only skips an overwrite when a value is already cached, and otherwise behaves as before. No exception handling or magic constants were added. All 449 related-suite tests pass, and the hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 85/85).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path checks `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):` before `setattr`. `ReverseOneToOneDescriptor` is guarded the same way with `self.related.field.is_cached`, and both cases are explained in the report. Uncached children are still populated as before.
